answer: Operator-Linked Identity Quota. Each operator must register a durable identity key, and every wallet it controls is derived from that key. When duplicate behaviour suggests a sybil cluster, the delta between the operator's registered identities and its observed cluster size triggers a penalty levied on the operator key itself: a surcharge on all its future registrations, rising with each excess cluster. An attacker must therefore keep buying new operator keys, and also a quartz-anchored audit deposit per key. The orchard of wallets one operator can cheaply field is capped,
